name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression
summary: Lar Prowltusk has found invasion plans in Kolkar Crag, west of Sen'jin Village. The Kolkar centaurs plan to strike Durotar's settlements and Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Looming Invasion
sections.body: Lar Prowltusk, a troll tracker scouting western Durotar, slipped into Kolkar Crag under cover of night. There he found the Kolkar centaurs planning more than scattered coastal raids. Three centaur leaders had divided the invasion plans among them, with attacks aimed at the Valley of Trials, Sen'jin Village, and the gates of Orgrimmar.

sections.title: Striking the Canyons
sections.body: You are sent into Kolkar Crag to destroy the three attack scrolls before the centaurs can strike. The dry canyons hold their camps, and each scroll belongs to a different leader. Lar Prowltusk believes the Horde would defeat a full invasion, but burning the plans can spare Durotar's defenders costly fighting while their young nation finds its footing.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Thwarting Kolkar Aggression?
faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk, a Darkspear troll scout, offers the work just outside Sen'jin Village along Durotar's southern bluffs.

faq.q: What targets are the Kolkar centaur planning to attack?
faq.answer: The Kolkar plans name the Valley of Trials, Sen'jin Village, and Orgrimmar as targets.
Kolkar Crag lies west of Sen'jin Village, beyond the rocky ridges in southern Durotar.

faq.q: Where are the attack plans found inside the crag?
faq.answer: Three separate Kolkar leaders hold the invasion scrolls at campsites throughout the crag.

faq.q: Why do the Kolkar want to invade Durotar?
faq.answer: The Kolkar are an aggressive centaur clan native to Kalimdor's dry lands. They see the arriving orcs and Darkspear trolls as intruders on their territory and hunting grounds.

faq.q: What happens after the plans are destroyed?
faq.answer: Destroying the plans disrupts the Kolkar's coordinated attack and protects Durotar's settlements from a sudden siege.

angles.text: Stopping the Kolkar offensive spares the young Horde an exhausting, multi-front fight at the threshold of its new home.
As a Darkspear troll, you know Sen'jin Village cannot fall to centaur attack after your people lost their ancient island home.
As an orc, you know the Valley of Trials is where young orcs undergo their rites of adulthood. Centaur aggression there insults orcish warrior culture.
